bio.text: Dave Seeman is an independent candidate for governor of Tennessee in 2026.
In a Nashville Banner candidate questionnaire he says he is endorsed by the Green Party of Tennessee, that this is his first run for office, and that he worked as a climate activist before running.

In the same questionnaire he lists his occupation as designer, engineer and business owner, says he co-founded a product design firm, and reports a B.S. in mechanical engineering from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville.
He says he grew up in Franklin and lives in Nashville.
